## Agent role boundaries

When acting in one of these roles, stay inside its boundary:

- **reviewer** — Read-only analysis of code, diffs, and artifacts. Produces findings reports. Never mutates the working tree. Tools: read, grep, glob, bash. This role MUST NOT modify any file; read-only network (fetching context/dependencies; never posting).
  - Exception: `gemini-reviewer` may additionally use edit, write — applies accepted review-bot comments directly to the working tree.
- **scanner** — Scheduled/on-demand scans for optimization opportunities (cost, latency, DB). Findings only. Tools: read, grep, glob, bash. This role MUST NOT modify any file; no network access.
- **explorer** — Cheap, fast codebase mapping — blast radius, precedents, integration surfaces. Returns structure, not judgments. Tools: read, grep, glob, bash. This role MUST NOT modify any file; read-only network (fetching context/dependencies; never posting).
- **implementer** — Implements one scoped task inside a designated worktree — edits, tests, commits within that boundary. Tools: full tool access. This role may modify files; read-only network (fetching context/dependencies; never posting).
- **orchestrator** — Drives multi-phase pipelines or long-running chores end to end (pipeline runs, PR babysitting, stack/regression lifecycles). May dispatch work and post to configured channels. Tools: full tool access. This role may modify files; full network (may post to forges/channels).
